meta.siteTitle: La Maison Val d'Or — Fine Jewellery, Diamonds & Rare Gemstones
meta.siteDescription: Certified diamonds, coloured gemstones and hand-finished gold jewellery, shipped worldwide from our atelier partners. Prices in your currency, service in your language.

home.heroSubtitle: Certified natural and lab-grown diamonds, coloured gemstones and hand-finished gold, sourced from vetted ateliers and delivered to your door in 6 to 12 working days.
home.featuredSubtitle: A rotating selection from the atelier floor.
home.collectionsSubtitle: Every piece is made to order and quality-checked before dispatch.
home.storyTitle: A different way to buy fine jewellery
home.storyBody: We do not hold stock in a back room. Each piece is produced or released by the atelier that makes it, certified, then shipped directly to you. Fewer hands, fewer margins, the same stones.
home.newsletterBody: New arrivals, one letter a month. No noise.
home.newsletterConsent: By subscribing you accept our privacy policy. Unsubscribe at any time.
home.newsletterThanks: Thank you — please confirm from the email we just sent.

usp.shippingBody: Tracked and insured to over 100 countries.
usp.certBody: IGI / GIA reports on certified pieces.
usp.returnsBody: Change of mind covered on stock pieces.
usp.payBody: Encrypted checkout, no card data stored.
